import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"extract_metadata\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<html><head><title>Company</title></head><body><div itemscope itemtype=\"https://schema.org/Organization\"><span itemprop=\"name\">Acme Corp</span><span itemprop=\"foundingDate\">2020</span><span itemprop=\"url\">https://acmecorp.example.com</span><span itemprop=\"logo\">https://acmecorp.example.com/logo.png</span></div></body></html>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
